name: Dagu
description: Workflow engine that runs scheduled jobs from simple YAML files

paths.name: Dagu
paths.description: Your workflows (dags), run history, logs, users and settings. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Dagu web app and API, published on host as 6853

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: DAGU_TZ
variables.description: The time zone schedules run in. It is filled in from your MOS time zone.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.
